about_the_game:
Introduction

This game contains horror elements, including graphic gore. Players with heart conditions or strong aversions to such content should proceed with caution.

Game Overview

Set in the late-1990s development studio of the never-released “Tokimeki Strip Rock-Paper-Scissors,” this faux-documentary horror adventure (ADV) draws you into the mystery behind a long-buried incident.

Key Features

  • Dual-screen progression – A gameplay screen and a novel screen run in parallel; you’ll switch between them to advance the story.

  • Distinctive 1990s visuals – From the adorable “Tokimeki Strip Rock-Paper-Scissors” cast to the in-story dev team, every sprite and background channels the look and feel of classic ’90s visual novels.

  • A tale darker than it appears – Behind the cute exterior, H9 delivers an unexpectedly intense psychological horror experience.

Warnings

This title includes depictions of violence, blood, psychological distress, sexual themes, and shocking live-action sequences. Certain effects may appear to tamper with your PC environment, but no harmful code is present. Enjoy the experience without worry…
